label: the reviewer prompt's flaked list runs past the variant heading, so a one-sample variant is presented as an unreproduced first-walk failure
old:
# The flaked lines only: confirm.txt's variant section (1b1) is a different list and must
    # not be read as an unreproduced first-walk failure.
    awk 'NR > 1 && /^variant \(/ { exit } NR > 1' "$UXD/confirm.txt" 2>/dev/null
new:
# The flaked lines only: confirm.txt's variant section (1b1) is a different list and must
    # not be read as an unreproduced first-walk failure.
    tail -n +2 "$UXD/confirm.txt" 2>/dev/null

label: the confirm-only re-ask runs past the variant heading, so it invites a below-3 score grounded in a one-sample variant the gate keeps as evidence
